title: Walk through the park
text: Our guide Angeles was amazing. She was very friendly, knowledgable and really enjoyable to be around. She spoke good English but also speaks Spanish and French,
author: snharper07

title: A very nice tour
text: We have been on the tour today of Maria Luisa Park and the Spanish Steps. The time has accompanied and the square wonderful, but what has been a real luxury are the guides. Emilio and Rafa have been very attentive and have shared with us their love for the city as well as a lot of interesting curiosities. Don't miss it!
author: X7380WFjaviers

title: Visit Maria Luisa Park and Plaza de España
text: Nieves, our guide, was very friendly and friendly. The explanations were enjoyable and entertaining Very happy with the visit. Highly recommended
author: Excursion28196232365

title: Very informative tour with Ismael.
text:
We had a great time at Plaza de España and Maria Luisa Park. Ismail our tour guide was very good. He was very knowledgeable and engaging. He shared lots of fun facts about the Spanish history and made the whole experience quite enjoyable. We highly recommend Ismael.
Make sure you ask him to take photos of you, he is a great photographer.
author: Jakimigu

title: Everything great!!
text: It has been a wonderful experience! We loved the visit. Many thanks to Cristina and Laura for your work! It has been a pleasure. Greetings from your group of Ukrainians!
author: Ole4ka7

title: A highly recommended alternative visit
text: The visit was extremely interesting and I learned a lot from our excellent guide Maripaz. A professional and knowledgeable about her city. Totally recommended.
